notes: The 10th house and its lord's navamsa describe the means of livelihood.

rules.text: Sun in the 10th house: wealth tends to come through the father.
rules.note: The text counts the 10th from the ascendant or the Moon, whichever is stronger; encoded from the ascendant.

rules.text: Moon in the 10th house: wealth tends to come through the mother.
rules.note: The text counts the 10th from the ascendant or the Moon, whichever is stronger; encoded from the ascendant.

rules.text: Mars in the 10th house: wealth tends to come through opponents or rivals.
rules.note: The text counts the 10th from the ascendant or the Moon, whichever is stronger; encoded from the ascendant.

rules.text: Mercury in the 10th house: wealth tends to come through friends.
rules.note: The text counts the 10th from the ascendant or the Moon, whichever is stronger; encoded from the ascendant.

rules.text: Jupiter in the 10th house: wealth tends to come through siblings.
rules.note: The text counts the 10th from the ascendant or the Moon, whichever is stronger; encoded from the ascendant.

rules.text: Venus in the 10th house: wealth tends to come through the spouse.
rules.note: The text counts the 10th from the ascendant or the Moon, whichever is stronger; encoded from the ascendant.

rules.text: Saturn in the 10th house: wealth tends to come through employees or helpers.
rules.note: The text counts the 10th from the ascendant or the Moon, whichever is stronger; encoded from the ascendant.

rules.text: The 10th lord is in a navamsa ruled by Sun: livelihood through medicine, orchards and trees, wool, metalwork, mantra and ritual work, or service under government or a person of standing.
rules.note: The text uses the strongest of the 10th lords from the ascendant, Moon and Sun; encoded from the ascendant. A few disreputable occupations in the list are omitted.

rules.text: The 10th lord is in a navamsa ruled by Moon: livelihood through water and sea produce (pearls, coral), agriculture and dairy, work connected with pilgrimage, service under a woman, or the clothing trade.
rules.note: The text uses the strongest of the 10th lords from the ascendant, Moon and Sun; encoded from the ascendant. A few disreputable occupations in the list are omitted.

rules.text: The 10th lord is in a navamsa ruled by Mars: livelihood through metals, gold, land, cooking, weapons, the military or security work, and bold, risky ventures.
rules.note: The text uses the strongest of the 10th lords from the ascendant, Moon and Sun; encoded from the ascendant. A few disreputable occupations in the list are omitted.

rules.text: The 10th lord is in a navamsa ruled by Mercury: livelihood through writing and poetry, scholarship and scripture, clerical and record-keeping work, astrology, teaching or priestly work.
rules.note: The text uses the strongest of the 10th lords from the ascendant, Moon and Sun; encoded from the ascendant. A few disreputable occupations in the list are omitted.

rules.text: The 10th lord is in a navamsa ruled by Jupiter: livelihood through teaching, religious instruction and law, work for scholars, temples or government, or money-lending and finance.
rules.note: The text uses the strongest of the 10th lords from the ascendant, Moon and Sun; encoded from the ascendant. A few disreputable occupations in the list are omitted.

rules.text: The 10th lord is in a navamsa ruled by Venus: livelihood through the arts (dance, music, performance), dairy and animals, silver, perfumes, jewellery and fine textiles, or work as a companion or aide to people in power.
rules.note: The text uses the strongest of the 10th lords from the ascendant, Moon and Sun; encoded from the ascendant. A few disreputable occupations in the list are omitted.

rules.text: The 10th lord is in a navamsa ruled by Saturn: livelihood through hard physical labour, managing workers, carrying and transport, crafts in wood and stone, sculpture, or coarse grains.
rules.note: The text uses the strongest of the 10th lords from the ascendant, Moon and Sun; encoded from the ascendant. A few disreputable occupations in the list are omitted.

variants.text: The 10th lord is strong: earnings come with little exertion.
The 10th lord is weak: earnings are modest.
The 10th lord occupies or aspects the 10th house: one earns in one's own country.
The 10th house is not occupied or aspected by its own lord: earnings tend to come from away from one's homeland.
